verdict.rationale: Authenticator documents a user-controlled "Usage Data" toggle in Settings that governs sharing of additional non-personal usage data. Diagnostic logs also stay on the device unless the user sends feedback. The word "additional" implies a baseline of data collection the user cannot switch off, so the opt-out covers only part of telemetry. Missing for 10: documented ability to opt out of all required/baseline telemetry, a clear statement of what is still collected with the toggle off, and independent hands-on verification of the toggle's effect.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: You can also allow the sharing of additional non-personal usage data by turning on the "Usage Data" toggle button on the app's Settings page.
Diagnostic log data that stays only in the app until you select Send feedback in the app's top menu to send logs to Microsoft.
